name: video_adversarial_review_follow_up
review: GPT-6.1 adversarial review of previous video experiments (session rubber-duck); key claims verified before acting

fused_ball_join_fix.bug: fuse_video_ball_observations checked speeds only between consecutive fused observations, not joins with retained tracking; 23 of 37 joins of the broadcast-ball fusion exceeded 65 m/s (median 80 m/s), 22 of them against predicted (extrapolated) frames
fused_ball_join_fix.fix: possession/trajectory.py _repair_fused_joins: a contradicted predicted run is dropped in favour of the observation; at observed/interpolated neighbours the fused run is trimmed until the join is feasible

cached_tactical_fills_retest.design: masked windows (tracking-observed ball hidden; fills cover ~70% of masked frames), today's default pipeline, official one-to-one spell F1 (IoU 0.3-0.7) vs the unmasked current run (teacher); development = half 1, frozen test = half 2
cached_tactical_fills_retest.decision: killed: frozen test negative; today's sequence model + broadcast fusion already recover what the fills add

replay_feasibility_count.design: other-view broadcast frames (valid homography, >=6 players, stride 5) matched by formation to tactical frames 3-180 s earlier (<=1 m)
replay_feasibility_count.decision: killed (< 500 useful frames): replays mostly re-show moments where the tactical ball was tracked

tactical_video_visibility_pilot.finding: the ball is usually visible to the tactical camera in real gaps: 3% of broadcast-ball references project off-screen; the ball model (yolo-sn-ball-opt) has a candidate within 5 m of the reference in 79% of on-screen reference frames
previous_failure_causes: 1.5 m match to a tracked ball that is itself 1-6 m off

conservative_operating_point.rule: ball model >= 0.3, no rival candidate, static-object exclusion, 4/4 neighbour persistence, within 1.5 m of a tracked player

broadcast_video_ball_detection.operating_point: yolo-sn-ball-opt full frame 1920 px conf >= 0.3; inside pitch +2 m; within 1.5 m of a tactical or broadcast player; 2-frame temporal support; raised-ball (over a person) rejection; outlier/step cleaning, 5-frame median

video_ball_swap_tests_vs_current_pipelin.design: masked windows (tactical ball hidden), today's default, official spell F1 vs unmasked teacher; local = windows +-10 s; touch variants also let broadcast-tracking fused frames count as touches match-wide, so 'whole' is confounded for them
video_ball_swap_tests_vs_current_pipelin.columns: [whole spell F1, local spell F1, masked-frame agreement]
video_ball_swap_tests_vs_current_pipelin.decision: not promoted: no consistent gain across halves; the sequence model + broadcast-tracking fusion already resolve what ball positions add; remaining errors need direct team/touch evidence

broadcast_scene_classes.classes: wide / zoomed / close-up / graphics / crowd-other from green share, person sizes and counts, red wipe share
broadcast_scene_classes.boundaries: scene changes coincide with homography loss/recovery (median +0.12 s / -0.08 s): nothing to refine
broadcast_scene_classes.close_ups_labelled_live: mostly broadcaster still on a replay after play resumed; flagging them hits 1.4% of live controls (fails 1%)
broadcast_scene_classes.narrow_rule: other-view close-up/crowd/graphics join cutaways: +544 live->D graded frames, 0 live controls hit; needs a committed per-frame scene array
broadcast_scene_classes.decision: not adopted (tiny, unproven, adds a frame-level artifact); confirms the broadcast cutaway cue

team_at_ball_from_kit_colours.colour_model: label-free kit prototypes from tracked players; 98.8% agreement on held-out matched players at confidence 0.9 (4.4% abstain); 24/24 disagreements were tracking errors

swap_test.columns: [whole spell F1, local, masked-frame agreement] vs unmasked teacher

team_at_ball_from_kit_colours.status: consistent gain on both halves (first video evidence to do so); not yet deployed: needs real-gap extraction, repo integration, weight licence check

goalkeeper_identity_swap.finding: metadata Goalkeeper tracks 23 (home) and 45 (away) swap identities: track 45 follows Barcelona's keeper on 16,392 graded frames (track 23 then a stray copy on grass), track 23 follows Athletic's keeper on 1,566 (7 episodes, shirt 26 readable)

evidence.slot45_sample: 120/150 lime home GK by automatic kit colour; ball at his feet 105/132
evidence.slot23_sample: 87/102 mint away GK by automatic kit colour

goalkeeper_identity_swap.fix: possession/tracking.py goalkeeper_frame_teams + extract_control_features(frame_teams): a goalkeeper track within goalkeeper_end_radius_metres (30) of the opponent's goal counts for the team defending it
goalkeeper_identity_swap.residual: 33 midfield frames of track 23 after a swapped stretch stay misassigned (sticky rule not adopted)

automatic_revalidation.method: tracking positions only (no video, kit colour or labels); same 30 m rule; a goalkeeper track counts as acting as keeper when it is the deepest player toward the goal it stands at
automatic_revalidation.conclusion: real goalkeepers at the opponent's goal (set pieces) are never the deepest player there; on the challenge both metadata goalkeeper tracks are, on 59% and 53% of rule-fire frames, so they follow the other team's keeper

track_team_audit.method: kit-colour classification of the person at every track's projected position, sampled each second (+0.2 s around stretch edges), automatic only
track_team_audit.outfield_tracks: 98-99.6% matched to a person; 95-99.8% colour agreement with team
track_team_audit.second_half_start: 6 away tracks follow home players for 124 s (5 ball-nearest frames, all D)

restart_taker_kit_team.decision: check only; no systematic restart-ownership error

team_at_ball_real_gaps.script: files/team_at_ball/extract_team_at_ball.py reproduces the swap-test evidence bit for bit; GPU bit-identical across GPUs; CPU 0 team disagreements but 5/52 fewer decisions
team_at_ball_real_gaps.caveat: 45% of evidence frames fall in stoppages (restarts); the swap test covered live windows only, so the 237 dead->live boundary shifts are untested

team_at_ball_team_pass.design: team-at-ball evidence enters only the second (team-choice) decoding pass via the ball-free penalty/support arrays; live/dead from the first pass

team_at_ball_tracked_frames.frames: graded tracked-ball live frames that are contested (both teams < 2 m) or near-miss (nearest 1.5-3 m): 24,670, every 2nd used (12,353); 3,139 decided
team_at_ball_tracked_frames.decision: killed: no better than tracking on tracked-ball frames; team-at-ball stays limited to tracking gaps
team_at_ball_tracked_frames.caveat: next_controller uses the same tracked ball as the tracking baseline

verified.evidence/track_team_override.npz: bit-identical after removing label statistics and paths from its provenance (sha 97179f97...)

regeneration_tools.determinism: GPU detection identical across GPUs and shard counts; CPU inference differs slightly

broadcast_team_at_ball.method: same rule on broadcast live-view frames with a separate label-free broadcast kit-colour model (GK slots 25/50)
broadcast_team_at_ball.decision: not promoted: mixed (dev up, frozen test down); the added frames are lower quality

restart_timing_from_video.coverage: video rest-then-kick found for 21 of 72 transitions without a tracked kick
restart_timing_from_video.decision: killed: fails the pre-set gate as specified; the passing variant is post hoc on 18 cases and the effect is tiny

team_at_ball_coverage_variants.decision: none accepted (acceptance needs both halves); current extractor kept
